title: I've been building an extraction RPG where the light from your lantern burns and weakens the dead
author: zanemoore575
selftext:
Hey what's up everyone! Zane here 😃 

I wanted to share a little clip of the game I've been developing with a bit of help from Claude: **Nightfall** \- a story driven, dark fantasy extraction RPG inspired by the atmosphere of classic fantasy RPGs and the tension of extraction games.

One of the core ideas behind the world is that light is more than just a way to see. It actively burns and weakens the dead, while darkness makes them stronger. Managing light becomes a big part of surviving the world.

I've recently put out a free early demo, and I'd love for people to give it a try and share their thoughts.

It's still a work in progress, would just genuinely love to hear what people think of the concept of the game, and the world so far.

You can play it here:  
[https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall](https://middafrostey.itch.io/nightfall)

Thanks for taking a look!

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/zanemoore575 please add a bit about how you used AI and what the development process looked like. A mention that AI was involved isn't enough. It needs dev details. Rule 4 exists so promotional posts contribute to the conversation about making games. We want to avoid the sub getting drowned in low effort promotion. If this isn't updated, it may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
